commits.message: feat(assets-gen): deterministic PNG atlas and WAV sound generators

checks.name: generate-twice
checks.command: pnpm --filter @voxelcraft/assets-gen run generate (run twice, sha256 of all 22 outputs compared)

notes.determinism: Two consecutive `run generate` invocations produced identical sha256 for all 22 files (diff exit 0). vitest additionally asserts buildAtlas/buildSounds byte equality across calls and writeAllAssets sha256 equality when written twice into the same dir and into two separate temp dirs.
notes.tests: 4 files, 23 tests: PNG round trip + chunk CRC + CRC32/Adler32 vectors + store-deflate inflate round trip, atlas completeness (layerOf/layers/missing at 0, unique 0..255), alpha policy per render layer, WAV header/chunk/sampleRate/non-silence, determinism.
notes.dependencies: No new dependencies. PNG uses node:zlib deflateSync with fixed options (level 9, memLevel 9, windowBits 15, default strategy) plus an own store-only deflate fallback; crc32 and adler32 are hand written. No Date.now, new Date or Math.random: all variation comes from core-types hashU32 / hash01 / makeRng.
decisions: atlas.json layers are row-major and exactly the 73 required names, missing at index 0; layerOf[name] === index holds for all.
Cutout tiles (plants, torch, ladder, redstone_wire, door_lower, door_upper) are snapped to alpha 0 or 255; door_lower/door_upper end up fully opaque by design.
Translucent tiles are water, ice, glass and lava (lava keeps an alpha 250 crust), each verified to contain 0 < a < 255 pixels.
grass_top, grass_side and the three leaves stay near grayscale so client-a can apply biome tint on vertex lane 7.
generated/** is never git added; root .gitignore was not modified.
docs/reports/client-b.json is committed on top of head_sha as a docs-only commit, so remote HEAD is one commit ahead of head_sha.
